2. For each new module (content_hash.rs, attestation.rs, provenance.rs, agent_trace.rs): confirm they exist and are registered in lib.rs
3. Check if there are ANY references to "D:\code\invesments" or "master_investments" or "rtk" in the source code (grep for these)
4. Verify Cargo.toml workspace deps include ed25519-dalek, rand, dirs
5. Check the proto/events.proto has the new event types (Provenance, Cost, Governance, Quality)
6. Check proto_generated.rs matches the proto file
7. Verify main.rs has the blame command and capture_provenance function
8. List any files that look like dead code or unused modules
9. Check if there are any TODO/FIXME/HACK comments in the new code
10. Report the full file tree of cli/crates/

Be very thorough - read every new file completely.
